question: Should OpenClaw adopt this Apple-only two-database GRDB migration now, before the corresponding Android ownership model exists?
rationale: The answer sets a durable cross-platform storage contract and accepts its migration/operational tradeoffs; tests can validate implementation details but cannot choose that product and ownership direction.

options.title: Sponsor the Apple-first migration
options.body: Accept the shared Apple database contract after upgrade/recovery evidence and native-check disposition are added.

options.title: Require a cross-platform design decision first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether Android must share the same durable-state ownership model before Apple data is migrated.

options.title: Narrow to non-migrating cleanup
options.body: Retain only behavior-neutral common code and defer persistent-store replacement to a separately approved migration.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Apple-first migration
recommendation.body: Accept the shared Apple database contract after upgrade/recovery evidence and native-check disposition are added.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the linked storage proposal and this Apple implementation, so they are the best available contact to clarify the intended migration boundary.
